Signed-off-by: Devanshi Jain <devanshijain@meta.com>
Co-authored-by: vllm-agent <claw@inferact.ai>

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The ready check and warmups of `vllm bench serve` send request 0 with a unique
+cache_salt, so they don't prime the prefix cache for the run, and drop the salt
+only if the server rejects it.
+
+Driven against a stub OpenAI completions server: no GPU or model.
+"""
+
+import asyncio
+import json
+from collections.abc import Callable
+
+import pytest
+from aiohttp import web
+from aiohttp.test_utils import TestServer
+
+from vllm.benchmarks.datasets import SampleRequest
+from vllm.benchmarks.serve import TaskType, benchmark
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skip_global_cleanup
+
+
+async def _salted_requests(status_for: Callable[[int, bool], int]) -> list[bool]:
+    """Runs the ready check, 2 warmups and 1 measured request. Returns, for each
+    request the server got, whether it carried a cache_salt.
+
+    `status_for(n, salted)` is the HTTP status for the server's n-th request.
+    """
+    salted: list[bool] = []
+
+    async def completions(request: web.Request) -> web.StreamResponse:
+        salted.append("cache_salt" in await request.json())
+        status = status_for(len(salted), salted[-1])
+        if status != 200:
+            return web.Response(status=status)
+        response = web.StreamResponse(headers={"Content-Type": "text/event-stream"})
+        await response.prepare(request)
+        for chunk in (
+            {"choices": [{"text": "hi"}]},
+            {"usage": {"prompt_tokens": 1, "completion_tokens": 1}},
+        ):
+            await response.write(f"data: {json.dumps(chunk)}\n\n".encode())
+        await response.write(b"data: [DONE]\n\n")
+        return response
+
+    app = web.Application()
+    app.router.add_post("/v1/completions", completions)
+    async with TestServer(app) as server:
+        base_url = str(server.make_url("")).rstrip("/")
+        await benchmark(
+            task_type=TaskType.GENERATION,
+            endpoint_type="openai",
+            api_url=f"{base_url}/v1/completions",
+            base_url=base_url,
+            model_id="stub",
+            model_name="stub",
+            tokenizer=None,
+            input_requests=[
+                SampleRequest(prompt="hello", prompt_len=1, expected_output_len=1)
+            ],
+            logprobs=None,
+            request_rate=float("inf"),
+            burstiness=1.0,
+            disable_tqdm=True,
+            num_warmups=2,
+            profile=False,
+            selected_percentile_metrics=["ttft"],
+            selected_percentiles=[99.0],
+            ignore_eos=False,
+            goodput_config_dict={},
+            max_concurrency=1,
+            lora_modules=None,
+            extra_headers=None,
+            extra_body=None,
+            ready_check_timeout_sec=30,
+        )
+    return salted
+
+
+def test_transient_ready_check_error_keeps_cache_salt():
+    salted = asyncio.run(_salted_requests(lambda n, _: 503 if n == 1 else 200))
+    # ready check (503), ready check retry, 2 warmups, measured request
+    assert salted == [True, True, True, True, False]
+
+
+def test_rejected_cache_salt_falls_back_despite_transient_error():
+    salted = asyncio.run(
+        _salted_requests(
+            lambda n, has_salt: (503 if n == 3 else 400) if has_salt else 200
+        )
+    )
+    # ready check (400) + unsalted, warmups (503, 400) + 2 unsalted, measured request
+    assert salted == [True, False, True, True, False, False, False]
+
+
+def test_rejected_cache_salt_falls_back_to_unsalted():
+    salted = asyncio.run(_salted_requests(lambda _, has_salt: 400 if has_salt else 200))
+    # ready check (400) + unsalted, 2 warmups (400) + 2 unsalted, measured request
+    assert salted == [True, False, True, True, False, False, False]

+def _with_unique_cache_salt(request_func_input: RequestFuncInput) -> RequestFuncInput:
+    """Copy with a fresh `cache_salt`, so the request cannot hit, or be hit by,
+    other requests in the prefix cache."""
+    return replace(
+        request_func_input,
+        extra_body={
+            **(request_func_input.extra_body or {}),
+            "cache_salt": f"warmup-{uuid.uuid4().hex}",
+        },
+    )
+
+
+def _rejects_cache_salt(output: RequestFuncOutput) -> bool:
+    """Whether the server refused the request as invalid (HTTP 400 or 422), as a
+    server that does not accept `cache_salt` does. Other failures can be
+    transient, so they are retried with the salt."""
+    return output.status_code in (400, 422)
+

     assert outputs[0] == outputs[1]
 
 
+def test_hybrid_sliding_window_honors_user_block_size(vllm_runner):
+    """A user-specified block size must hold for sliding-window groups too, so
+    a one-block prefix is cacheable. Guards against backends picking a larger
+    sliding-window block when the worker builds KV cache specs.
+    """
+    block_size = 16
+    prompt = {"prompt_token_ids": [101] * (block_size + 1)}
+    sampling_params = SamplingParams(max_tokens=1)
+    with vllm_runner(
+        "google/gemma-3-1b-it",
+        block_size=block_size,
+        enable_prefix_caching=True,
+        max_model_len=1024,
+        enforce_eager=True,
+    ) as runner:
+        llm = runner.get_llm()
+        llm.generate([prompt], sampling_params)
+        outputs = llm.generate([prompt], sampling_params)
+    assert outputs[0].num_cached_tokens == block_size
+

+def is_deep_gemm_fp8_linear_requested(kernel_config: "KernelConfig") -> bool:
+    """Check if the user selected DeepGemm for block-scaled FP8 linear layers.
+

-      The MI355X AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`kimik3.1-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#5089](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/5089)), one TP8 engine on the node's eight GPUs. It keeps linear layers, MoE combine and all-reduce in BF16 and has been measured only on the image digest the preset pins.
+      The MI355X AgentX lane in [SemiAnalysis InferenceX](https://inferencex.semianalysis.com/) (`kimik3.1-fp4-mi355x-vllm-agentic-dspark`, [SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX#5119](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/5119)), one TP8 engine on the node's eight GPUs. It keeps linear layers, MoE combine and all-reduce in BF16 and has been measured only on the image digest the preset pins.
 
       **Points.**
-      - **Concurrency 1: plain TP8, no DCP, KV cache on the GPU.** At one request DCP's extra KV capacity isn't needed: the server log reports 2.8M KV tokens, 2.7x a 1M-token request. The DSpark draft runs 7 tokens, `--max-num-seqs` is 1, and the capture sizes 2 to 16 cover the 8-row decode step (1 + 7). `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE=1` runs each DSA layer's decode prologue as one launch; it needs DCP off.
-      - **Concurrency 4: DCP8, KV cache on the GPU.** 5 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 2`, so a decode step is at most 12 rows (2 × (1 + 5)) and the capture sizes are 6 and 12. DCP8 holds 19.1M KV tokens on the GPUs.
-      - **Concurrency 16, 24 and 32: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill every 32 engine steps.** `--max-num-seqs` is 8, 13 and 20, below the concurrency, with 4, 4 and 3 draft tokens. `--prefill-schedule-interval 32` admits prefill only once every 32 engine steps, so decode runs in long uninterrupted stretches. With fewer slots than clients, requests always wait, and vLLM would otherwise drop the hold on any step that leaves requests waiting; `VLLM_PREFILL_CADENCE_NO_ESCAPE=1` keeps it. Concurrency 32 also runs `--max-num-batched-tokens 10240` at 0.91 memory utilization.
-      - **Concurrency 48: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill on every step.** 3 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 48`. Decode batches are at most 48 × 4 rows, so the sizes 4 to 192 in steps of 4 cover every decode step, and the list continues to 10240, the value of `--max-num-batched-tokens`.
+      - **Concurrency 1: plain TP8, no DCP, KV cache on the GPU.** At one request DCP's extra KV capacity isn't needed: the server log reports 3.2M KV tokens, 3x a 1M-token request. The DSpark draft runs 7 tokens, `--max-num-seqs` is 1, and the capture sizes 2 to 16 cover the 8-row decode step (1 + 7). `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE=1` runs each DSA layer's decode prologue as one launch; it needs DCP off.
+      - **Concurrency 4: DCP8, KV cache on the GPU.** 5 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 2`, so a decode step is at most 12 rows (2 × (1 + 5)) and the capture sizes are 6 and 12. DCP8 holds 18.1M KV tokens on the GPUs.
+      - **Concurrency 16, 24 and 32: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill every 32 engine steps.** `--max-num-seqs` is 8, 13 and 20, below the concurrency, with 4 draft tokens. `--prefill-schedule-interval 32` admits prefill only once every 32 engine steps, so decode runs in long uninterrupted stretches. With fewer slots than clients, requests always wait, and vLLM would otherwise drop the hold on any step that leaves requests waiting; `VLLM_PREFILL_CADENCE_NO_ESCAPE=1` keeps it. Concurrency 32 also runs `--max-num-batched-tokens 10240` at 0.91 memory utilization.
+      - **Concurrency 48: DCP8 with host KV offload, prefill on every step.** 4 draft tokens at `--max-num-seqs 48`. Decode batches are at most 48 × 5 rows, so the sizes 5 to 240 in steps of 5 cover every decode step, and the list continues to 10240, the value of `--max-num-batched-tokens`.
 
       **Serving config.**
-      - **Low-latency decode** (the Low-latency decode feature, on at concurrency 1 and 4) sets `decode_backend: latency_specialized`. On MI355X it runs pure decode steps of up to 16 rows on fused FlyDSL kernels; prefill and mixed steps run the default path. Among other startup checks, it needs: TP8 with no expert, data or pipeline parallelism; AITER on, the `ROCM_AITER_MLA` attention backend and an fp8 (E4M3) KV cache; speculative decoding on; no KV offload connector; `--max-num-seqs` 1, 2, 4 or 8 with `--max-num-seqs` × (1 + draft tokens) ≤ 16; a BF16 KDA `in_proj` (no `--quantization-config`); and an FP32 KDA recurrent state. Without DCP it serves only 3 or 7 draft tokens with `--max-num-seqs` 1 or 2. At concurrency 1 the server log shows the fused path running the sparse MLA attention itself (the one-launch prologue, the indexer's scoring and DSA split-K, 16 splits); under DCP8 at concurrency 4 the MLA layers run vLLM's attention ops and the rest of the layer is fused. The pinned image also turns on this path's low-concurrency speedups by default: the `VLLM_K31_BEAT_*` variables and `VLLM_K3_INDEXER_SAMPLED_TOPK`, plus `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE_INDEXER` where `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE` is on (concurrency 1). All of them default to 1, so the preset sets none. Some act only at one request: at concurrency 4 the server log reports the fused Markov draft step off with more than one request. The decode backend used from concurrency 16 ignores them.
+      - **Low-latency decode** (the Low-latency decode feature, on at concurrency 1 and 4) sets `decode_backend: latency_specialized`. On MI355X it runs pure decode steps of up to 16 rows on fused FlyDSL kernels; prefill and mixed steps run the default path. Without DCP it serves only 3 or 7 draft tokens with `--max-num-seqs` 1 or 2. At concurrency 1 the server log shows the fused path running the sparse MLA attention itself (the one-launch prologue, the indexer's scoring and DSA split-K, 16 splits); under DCP8 at concurrency 4 the MLA layers run vLLM's attention ops and the rest of the layer is fused. The pinned image also turns on this path's low-concurrency speedups by default: the `VLLM_K31_BEAT_*` variables and `VLLM_K3_INDEXER_SAMPLED_TOPK`, plus `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE_INDEXER` where `VLLM_KIMI_SD_DSA_PROLOGUE` is on (concurrency 1). All of them default to 1, so the preset sets none. Some act only at one request: at concurrency 4 the server log reports the fused Markov draft step off with more than one request. `VLLM_K31_BEAT_CTXKV` (the draft's context K/V stored in one launch for its 5 layers) needs a BF16 draft KV cache, which is why these two points leave the draft's attention backend and KV dtype to the image. The decode backend used from concurrency 16 ignores them.
       - **CUDA graphs.** K3.1 has no `torch.compile` submodule, so vLLM resolves `FULL_AND_PIECEWISE` to `FULL_DECODE_ONLY` and captures decode only. Breakable graphs (`VLLM_USE_BREAKABLE_CUDAGRAPH=1`, from the AMD profile) are what let the points from concurrency 16 capture the prefill sizes too. They cost graph memory, which comes out of the KV cache, so keep the capture list to the sizes the workload uses. Concurrency 1 and 4 capture decode sizes only and set it to 0.
       - **`--max-num-batched-tokens` 16384 (10240 at concurrency 32 and 48).** With prefix caching, the hybrid KV manager ends every non-final prefill chunk on a block boundary; the server log reports a KV block of 9216 tokens under DCP8 and 1280 without DCP (`kv lcm block sizes`).
+      - **`--prefix-match-unit` 1152 (1280 at concurrency 1).** The unit is the attention block span: 1152 tokens under DCP8 and 1280 without DCP (`Setting attention block size to ...` in the server log), and it must divide it. On the 5c14fe8 image, the draft's sliding-window KV group matched only whole blocks, so a 64-token unit turned off fine-grained prefix-cache hits for the whole model and rounded every hit down to the 9216-token block. The pinned image adds fine-grained lookups for sliding-window groups (`VLLM_SWA_FINE_GRAINED_PREFIX_HITS`, on by default); InferenceX kept the block span and did not re-measure 64 on it.
       - **`--gpu-memory-utilization` 0.90 (0.91 at concurrency 32 and 48) and `VLLM_ROCM_MEM_HEADROOM_GIB=8`.** Kernel scratch is allocated outside this budget, so leave headroom. The memory profile also misses some DCP prefill transients, so the headroom variable caps torch's allocator 8 GiB below free memory (`Allocator headroom: ... headroom 8.0 GiB` in the server log).
-      - **`VLLM_K3_SP_PREFILL=1`** (set on every point, active under DCP8). In batches of at least 4096 tokens (prefill and large mixed steps), the residual stream stays token-sharded across the TP ranks, so each MoE layer's three all-reduces (attention output, routed latent and MoE output) become reduce-scatters and all-gathers over symmetric memory. These sum the TP partials in FP32 in a fixed order. Decode steps and smaller batches are unchanged. The server log reports `sequence-parallel prefill enabled (batches of >= 4096 tokens)` at concurrency 4 to 48; at concurrency 1 (no DCP) it reports the configuration unsupported and the default all-reduce path runs, and the variable is kept there as InferenceX ran it.
+      - **`VLLM_K3_SP_PREFILL=1`** (set on every point). In batches of at least 4096 tokens (prefill and large mixed steps), the residual stream stays token-sharded across the TP ranks, so each MoE layer's three all-reduces (attention output, routed latent and MoE output) become reduce-scatters and all-gathers over symmetric memory. These sum the TP partials in FP32 in a fixed order. Decode steps and smaller batches are unchanged. The server log reports `sequence-parallel prefill enabled (batches of >= 4096 tokens)` at every point; the pinned image also runs it without DCP (concurrency 1), where the routed experts' MXFP4 input is quantized before the gather.
       - **DCP8** shards the MLA latent and indexer-key caches across the TP group, with the A2A DCP backend and `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1`. `VLLM_ROCM_DCP_VUP_RS=1` applies `v_up` first and then sums the ranks with AITER's LSE all-gather and reduce-scatter, for the target's MLA layers; it needs `VLLM_ROCM_DCP_AITER_ALLGATHER=1`. `VLLM_ROCM_DSA_MULTISTREAM=1` runs the DSA indexer, the DCP score all-gather and merge, and the gate on a second stream in decode. Concurrency 1 keeps these variables as InferenceX ran it; with DCP off they are expected to have no effect.
       - **The indexer key cache is MXFP4** (`indexer_kv_dtype`). AITER needs padded FP4 indexer pages for it. Stock AITER asserts on the page stride at startup. `kda_prefill_backend: fused` prefills the KDA layers with the fused gfx950 kernel.
-      - **Spec decoding** (the Spec decoding feature, on in this preset) uses the K3.1 DSpark draft [`Inferact/Kimi-K3.1-Pro-DSpark`](https://huggingface.co/Inferact/Kimi-K3.1-Pro-DSpark) (5 GQA layers, 2,048-token sliding window) with `TRITON_ATTN` attention, probabilistic drafting and block rejection; each point sets its draft token count.

From concurrency 16 the draft runs `TRITON_ATTN` with an fp8 KV cache, the target's dtype. At concurrency 1 and 4 the preset sets neither, and the pinned image picks `KIMI_K3_FLYDSL_SWA_GQA` (`TRITON_ATTN` with a FlyDSL kernel for the draft's decode and verify calls, `VLLM_K31_DRAFT_FLYDSL_ATTN`, default 1) with a BF16 draft KV cache; the server log reports `Using KIMI_K3_FLYDSL_SWA_GQA backend`.

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""A stand-in for the `configuration_nemotron4.py` that Nemotron Shortcut
+checkpoints ship as remote code, for the tests' tiny random-weight models.
+vLLM reads the model's fields as attributes, so these configs keep every field
+they are given. `utils.save_checkpoint_config` saves this module next to a
+tiny model's config.json, so the engine loads it as the checkpoint's own."""
+
+from transformers import PreTrainedConfig
+from transformers.models.pixtral import PixtralVisionConfig
+
+
+class Nemotron4TextConfig(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "nemotron4_text"
+    base_config_key = "text_config"
+
+    @property
+    def num_hidden_layers(self) -> int:
+        return len(self.layer_types)
+
+    def validate_layer_type(self):
+        # The model's own block types, e.g. "mlp" and "shortcut_moe_gdp".
+        pass
+
+
+class Nemotron4Config(PreTrainedConfig):
+    model_type = "nemotron4"
+    sub_configs = {
+        "text_config": Nemotron4TextConfig,
+        "vision_config": PixtralVisionConfig,
+    }
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        text_config: dict | Nemotron4TextConfig | None = None,
+        vision_config: dict | PixtralVisionConfig | None = None,
+        **kwargs,
+    ):
+        kwargs.setdefault("architectures", ["Nemotron4ForConditionalGeneration"])
+        super().__init__(**kwargs)
+        if not isinstance(text_config, Nemotron4TextConfig):
+            text_config = Nemotron4TextConfig(**(text_config or {}))
+        if not isinstance(vision_config, PixtralVisionConfig):
+            vision_config = PixtralVisionConfig(**(vision_config or {}))
+        self.text_config = text_config
+        self.vision_config = vision_config

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The CuTe-DSL MXFP8 experts against a reference (the Triton experts are covered
+by `test_moe.py`)."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="needs CUDA")
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not any(current_platform.is_device_capability(cap) for cap in (100, 103)),
+    reason="The CuTe-DSL MXFP8 experts need SM10x",
+)
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tokens", [7, 32])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("hidden,intermediate", [(128, 256), (256, 128)])
+@torch.inference_mode()
+def test_cute_dsl_mxfp8_experts_apply_the_clamp(tokens, hidden, intermediate):
+    """The CuTe-DSL MXFP8 experts with a clamp that bites, against a
+    reference that quantizes as they do."""
+    from torch import nn
+
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.activation import MoEActivation
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.config import (
+        FusedMoEParallelConfig,
+        FusedMoEQuantConfig,
+        RoutingMethodType,
+    )
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.utils.mxfp8_utils import (
+        dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16,
+        mxfp8_e4m3_quantize,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.moe.config import (
+        NemotronShortcutMoEConfig,
+    )
+    from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.moe.flashinfer import (
+        NemotronShortcutCuteDslMxfp8Experts,
+        has_cute_dsl_mxfp8,
+    )
+
+    if not has_cute_dsl_mxfp8():
+        pytest.skip("FlashInfer without CuTe-DSL MXFP8 ClampedRelu2")
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    device = torch.device("cuda")
+    # The model's activation: relu(c * tanh(x / c)) ** 2, not gated. A small c
+    # makes the clamp change the output.
+    experts, topk, clamp = 8, 2, 0.25
+
+    def quantize(value):
+        flat = value.reshape(-1, value.shape[-1]).contiguous()
+        quant, scales = mxfp8_e4m3_quantize(flat, is_sf_swizzled_layout=False)
+        return quant.reshape(value.shape), scales.reshape(*value.shape[:-1], -1)
+
+    weights = nn.Module()
+    for name, shape in (
+        ("w13", (experts, intermediate, hidden)),
+        ("w2", (experts, hidden, intermediate)),
+    ):
+        quant, scales = quantize(
+            torch.randn(shape, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16) * 0.1
+        )
+        weights.register_buffer(f"{name}_weight", quant)
+        weights.register_buffer(f"{name}_weight_scale", scales)
+    config = NemotronShortcutMoEConfig(
+        num_experts=experts,
+        experts_per_token=topk,
+        hidden_dim=hidden,
+        intermediate_size=intermediate,
+        num_local_experts=experts,
+        num_logical_experts=experts,
+        moe_parallel_config=FusedMoEParallelConfig.make_no_parallel(),
+        activation=MoEActivation.RELU2_NO_MUL,
+        activation_clamp_value=clamp,
+        in_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device=device,
+        routing_method=RoutingMethodType.TopK,
+        moe_backend="flashinfer_cutedsl",
+    )
+    quant_config = FusedMoEQuantConfig.make(
+        "mxfp8",
+        w1_scale=weights.w13_weight_scale,
+        w2_scale=weights.w2_weight_scale,
+        block_shape=[1, 32],
+        is_scale_swizzled=False,
+    )
+    kernel = NemotronShortcutCuteDslMxfp8Experts(config, quant_config)
+    kernel.process_weights_after_loading(weights)
+    x = torch.randn(tokens, hidden, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    ids = torch.rand(tokens, experts, device=device).topk(topk, dim=-1).indices
+    routing = torch.randn(tokens, topk, device=device).softmax(-1)
+    output = torch.empty_like(x)
+    kernel.apply(
+        output,
+        x,
+        weights.w13_weight,
+        weights.w2_weight,
+        routing,
+        ids,
+        MoEActivation.RELU2_NO_MUL,
+        experts,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        None,
+        False,
+    )
+    xref = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(*quantize(x)).float()
+    w1 = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(weights.w13_weight, weights.w13_weight_scale).float()
+    w2 = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(weights.w2_weight, weights.w2_weight_scale).float()
+    expected = torch.zeros_like(output, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for expert in range(experts):
+        rows, slots = torch.where(ids == expert)
+        if rows.numel() == 0:
+            continue
+        up = F.linear(xref[rows], w1[expert])
+        activated = (clamp * torch.tanh(up / clamp)).clamp_min(0).square()
+        activated = dequant_mxfp8_to_bf16(*quantize(activated.bfloat16())).float()
+        down = F.linear(activated, w2[expert])
+        expected.index_add_(0, rows, down * routing[rows, slots, None])
+    assert torch.isfinite(output).all()
+    error = (output.float() - expected).norm() / expected.norm()
+    assert error < 0.05, error.item()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Nemotron Shortcut's MoE layer: numerics, checkpoint loading and graph replay."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.models.utils import AutoWeightsLoader
+from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.moe import NemotronShortcutMoE
+from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.moe.flashinfer import has_cute_dsl_options
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_default_torch_dtype
+
+from ..utils import build, make_config
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="Triton experts need CUDA"
+)
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _forward_context(dist_init, workspace_init):
+    with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(None, get_current_vllm_config()):
+        yield
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("top_k,shared_size", [(1, None), (2, 16)])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("bias_space", ["score", "logit"])
+def test_matches_a_per_expert_reference(dtype, top_k, shared_size, bias_space):
+    """Selection-only bias, weighting before the down projection, FP32 sum.
+
+    `"logit"` selects on `logits + bias` instead of `sigmoid(logits) + bias`;
+    the mixing weights are the unbiased sigmoid scores either way.
+    """
+    config = make_config(
+        num_experts_per_tok=top_k,
+        moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size=shared_size,
+        moe_router_bias_space=bias_space,
+    )
+    with set_default_torch_dtype(dtype):
+        moe = build(lambda: NemotronShortcutMoE(config))
+    experts = moe.experts.routed_experts
+    # Exercise the soft clamp and the low-precision rounding.
+    experts.w13_weight.mul_(100)
+    bias = moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias
+    bias.copy_(torch.linspace(-0.6, 0.6, config.n_routed_experts, device="cuda"))
+    routed = torch.randn(7, config.hidden_size, device="cuda", dtype=dtype) * 3
+    shared = torch.randn_like(routed)
+
+    logits = F.linear(routed.float(), moe.gate.weight.float())
+    scores = logits.sigmoid()
+    ids = ((logits if bias_space == "logit" else scores) + bias).topk(top_k).indices
+    if bias_space == "logit":
+        # Otherwise this case would not tell the two spaces apart.
+        score_ids = (scores + bias).topk(top_k).indices
+        assert not torch.equal(ids.sort(-1).values, score_ids.sort(-1).values)
+    weights = scores.gather(1, ids)
+    if top_k > 1:
+        weights /= weights.sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-20
+    weights *= config.routed_scaling_factor
+    clamp = config.activation_clamp_value
+    latent = F.linear(routed, moe.fc1_latent_proj.weight)
+    expected = torch.zeros_like(latent, dtype=torch.float32)
+    for expert in range(config.n_routed_experts):
+        token, slot = torch.where(ids == expert)
+        hidden = F.linear(latent[token], experts.w13_weight[expert])
+        hidden = (clamp * torch.tanh(hidden.float() / clamp)).to(dtype)
+        hidden = (hidden.relu().square().float() * weights[token, slot, None]).to(dtype)
+        expected[token] += F.linear(hidden, experts.w2_weight[expert]).float()
+    expected = expected.to(dtype).float()
+    expected *= torch.rsqrt(
+        expected.square().mean(-1, keepdim=True) + config.rms_norm_eps
+    )
+    expected = expected.to(dtype) * moe.fc2_norm.weight
+    expected = F.linear(expected, moe.fc2_latent_proj.weight)
+    if shared_size is not None:
+        hidden = F.linear(shared, moe.shared_experts.up_proj.weight)
+        hidden = (clamp * torch.tanh(hidden.float() / clamp)).to(dtype)
+        expected += F.linear(
+            hidden.relu().square(), moe.shared_experts.down_proj.weight
+        )
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        moe(routed, shared),
+        expected,
+        atol=2e-3 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 2e-6,
+        rtol=2e-2 if dtype == torch.bfloat16 else 2e-5,
+    )
+
+
+def test_loads_packed_experts_and_router_bias():
+    """Loading overwrites every declared checkpoint tensor, experts included."""
+    moe = build(lambda: NemotronShortcutMoE(make_config()))
+    weights = {name: torch.randn_like(param) for name, param in moe.named_parameters()}
+    wrapper = nn.Module()
+    wrapper.moe = moe
+    checkpoint = {
+        "moe."
+        + name.replace("experts.routed_experts.w13_weight", "experts.up_proj").replace(
+            "experts.routed_experts.w2_weight", "experts.down_proj"
+        ): value
+        for name, value in weights.items()
+    }
+
+    assert AutoWeightsLoader(wrapper).load_weights(checkpoint.items()) == {
+        "moe." + name for name in weights
+    }
+    for name, param in moe.named_parameters():
+        torch.testing.assert_close(param, weights[name], atol=0, rtol=0)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_device_capability_family(100)
+    or not has_cute_dsl_options("routing_weights_before_fc2", "clamped_relu2_limit"),
+    reason="NVFP4 experts need SM10x and FlashInfer's routing_weights_before_fc2",
+)
+def test_loads_nvfp4_expert_scales_without_folding_twice():
+    """Fused checkpoint keys keep each expert's own global scales."""
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.quantization.modelopt import ModelOptNvFp4Config
+
+    quant = ModelOptNvFp4Config(
+        is_checkpoint_nvfp4_serialized=True,
+        exclude_modules=["*.fc1_latent_proj", "*.fc2_latent_proj"],
+    )
+    with set_default_torch_dtype(torch.bfloat16), torch.device("cuda"):
+        moe = NemotronShortcutMoE(
+            make_config(
+                hidden_size=256,
+                moe_latent_size=256,
+                moe_intermediate_size=512,
+                moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size=None,
+            ),
+            quant_config=quant,
+            prefix="moe",
+        )
+    experts = moe.experts.routed_experts
+    checkpoint, expected = {}, {}
+    per_expert = torch.arange(1, 9, device="cuda").float()
+    for projection, parameter, rows, width, byte in (
+        ("up_proj", "w13", 512, 256, 17),
+        ("down_proj", "w2", 256, 512, 91),
+    ):
+        tensors = {
+            ("", "_weight"): (per_expert[:, None, None] + byte)
+            .expand(8, rows, width // 2)
+            .to(torch.uint8)
+            .contiguous(),
+            ("_scale", "_weight_scale"): (per_expert[:, None, None] / 4)
+            .expand(8, rows, width // 16)
+            .to(torch.float8_e4m3fn)
+            .contiguous(),
+            ("_scale_2", "_weight_scale_2"): per_expert / 128,
+            ("_input_scale", "_input_scale"): per_expert / 1024,
+        }
+        for (source, target), tensor in tensors.items():
+            checkpoint[f"moe.experts.{projection}{source}"] = tensor
+            expected[parameter + target] = tensor.reshape_as(
+                getattr(experts, parameter + target)
+            )
+    wrapper = nn.Module()
+    wrapper.moe = moe
+
+    assert AutoWeightsLoader(wrapper).load_weights(checkpoint.items()) == {
+        "moe.experts.routed_experts." + name for name in expected
+    }
+    for name, tensor in expected.items():
+        actual = getattr(experts, name)
+        assert actual.dtype == tensor.dtype
+        torch.testing.assert_close(actual.float(), tensor.float(), atol=0, rtol=0)
+    experts.quant_method.process_weights_after_loading(experts)
+    assert experts.quant_method.moe_kernel is not None
+    kernel = experts.quant_method.moe_kernel.fused_experts
+    # The ModelOpt loader folds the shared activation scale exactly once.
+    for alphas, weight, activation in (
+        (kernel.g1_alphas, "w13_weight_scale_2", "w13_input_scale"),
+        (kernel.g2_alphas, "w2_weight_scale_2", "w2_input_scale"),
+    ):
+        assert alphas is not None
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            alphas.flatten(), expected[weight].flatten() * expected[activation].max()
+        )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("compiled", [False, True])
+def test_graph_replay_routes_the_new_inputs(compiled):
+    """A replayed capture routes the new inputs, not the captured ones."""
+    moe = build(lambda: NemotronShortcutMoE(make_config()))
+    forward = torch.compile(moe, fullgraph=True) if compiled else moe
+    moe.gate.e_score_correction_bias.zero_()
+    # More than 32 tokens: torch.compile cannot trace GateLinear's CuTe-DSL tier
+    # for at most 32 tokens, which vLLM never traces (it compiles at
+    # max_num_batched_tokens).
+    routed = torch.randn(48, 32, device="cuda")
+    shared = torch.randn_like(routed)
+    warmup = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    warmup.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(warmup):
+        for _ in range(3):
+            forward(routed, shared)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(warmup)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        output = forward(routed, shared)
+    graph.replay()
+    first = output.clone()
+    routed.neg_()  # Top-2 of eight logits becomes the bottom-2.
+    shared.add_(1)
+    graph.replay()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(output, moe(routed, shared), atol=2e-6, rtol=2e-5)
+    assert not torch.equal(output, first)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The staged MoE overlaps the DP all-gather and reduce-scatter with the mixer
+and the shared experts, without changing the results."""
+
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode, get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.prepare_finalize import naive_dp_ep
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.prepare_finalize.naive_dp_ep import (
+    MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNaiveDPEPModular,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.prepare_finalize.no_dp_ep import (
+    MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular,
+)
+from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.moe import (
+    NemotronShortcutMoE,
+    NemotronShortcutMoERunner,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+from vllm.utils.torch_utils import set_default_torch_dtype
+
+from ..utils import build as _build
+from ..utils import make_config as _config
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(not current_platform.is_cuda(), reason="CUDA")
+
+
+class _FakeEPGroup:
+    """Two-rank stand-in: gather duplicates rows, reduce-scatter folds them."""
+
+    def __init__(self) -> None:
+        self.streams: list[int] = []
+
+    def dispatch(self, x, topk_weights, topk_ids, is_sequence_parallel, extra_tensors):
+        assert extra_tensors is None
+        self.streams.append(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
+        # Slow enough that an unjoined consumer would observe stale data.
+        torch.cuda._sleep(2_000_000)
+        return (
+            torch.cat((x, x * 2)),
+            torch.cat((topk_weights, topk_weights * 2)),
+            torch.cat((topk_ids, topk_ids)),
+        )
+
+    def combine_into_output(self, hidden_states, output, is_sequence_parallel):
+        self.streams.append(torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream)
+        torch.cuda._sleep(2_000_000)
+        rows = output.shape[0]
+        torch.add(hidden_states[:rows], hidden_states[rows:], out=output)
+        return output
+
+    def allocate_combine_input(self, shape, dtype, device, is_sequence_parallel):
+        return None
+
+
+@pytest.fixture
+def group(dist_init, workspace_init, monkeypatch):
+    group = _FakeEPGroup()
+    monkeypatch.setattr(naive_dp_ep, "get_ep_group", lambda: group)
+    with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(None, get_current_vllm_config()):
+        yield group
+
+
+def _moe(dtype: torch.dtype) -> NemotronShortcutMoE:
+    """A layer on the all-gather/reduce-scatter transport, sized so that BF16
+    may select FlashInfer's experts (the `FusedMoEKernel.apply` path)."""
+    config = _config(
+        hidden_size=256,
+        moe_latent_size=128,
+        moe_intermediate_size=128,
+        moe_shared_expert_intermediate_size=128,
+    )
+    with set_default_torch_dtype(dtype):
+        moe = _build(lambda: NemotronShortcutMoE(config))
+    kernel = moe.experts.routed_experts.quant_method.moe_kernel
+    kernel.impl.prepare_finalize = MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNaiveDPEPModular()
+    return moe
+
+
+def _forward(moe, routed, shared):
+    """A shortcut block's stages, with a stand-in for the mixer."""
+    dispatch = moe.begin_staged(routed)
+    projection = shared * 0.5
+    dispatch = moe.receive_staged(dispatch, (projection,))
+    combine = moe.run_staged_experts(dispatch, projection)
+    return moe.finish_staged(combine, shared)
+
+
+def _synchronous(moe, routed, shared, forward=_forward):
+    with patch.object(NemotronShortcutMoERunner, "overlaps_transport", False):
+        return forward(moe, routed, shared).clone()
+
+
+def _inputs(moe):
+    torch.manual_seed(0)
+    # More than 32 tokens: torch.compile cannot trace GateLinear's CuTe-DSL tier
+    # below that, which vLLM never traces.
+    routed = torch.randn(48, 256, device="cuda", dtype=moe.gate.weight.dtype)
+    return routed, torch.randn_like(routed)
+
+
+def _warm_up(moe, routed, shared):
+    stream = torch.cuda.Stream()
+    stream.wait_stream(torch.cuda.current_stream())
+    with torch.cuda.stream(stream):
+        _forward(moe, routed, shared)
+    torch.cuda.current_stream().wait_stream(stream)
+
+
+def test_overlaps_only_the_all_gather_transport_without_dbo(group):
+    moe = _moe(torch.bfloat16)
+    runner = moe.experts
+    assert runner.overlaps_transport
+    runner.enable_dbo = True
+    assert not runner.overlaps_transport
+    runner.enable_dbo = False
+    kernel = runner.routed_experts.quant_method.moe_kernel
+    kernel.impl.prepare_finalize = MoEPrepareAndFinalizeNoDPEPModular()
+    assert not runner.overlaps_transport
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("compiled", [False, True])
+def test_overlap_matches_the_synchronous_transport(group, dtype, compiled):
+    moe = _moe(dtype)
+    routed, shared = _inputs(moe)
+    forward = torch.compile(_forward, fullgraph=True) if compiled else _forward
+    # The same graph: inductor rounds the code around the stages its own way.
+    expected = _synchronous(moe, routed, shared, forward)
+    compute_stream = torch.cuda.current_stream().cuda_stream
+    group.streams.clear()
+
+    actual = forward(moe, routed, shared)
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, atol=0, rtol=0)
+    assert len(group.streams) == 2
+    assert compute_stream not in group.streams
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_full_graph_replays_the_overlap(group, dtype):
+    """One capture of all stages: the experts and the finish join the side
+    stream inside it."""
+    moe = _moe(dtype)
+    routed, shared = _inputs(moe)
+    _warm_up(moe, routed, shared)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        output = _forward(moe, routed, shared)
+    routed.neg_()
+    shared.mul_(-0.5)
+
+    graph.replay()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        output, _synchronous(moe, routed, shared), atol=0, rtol=0
+    )
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("dtype", [torch.float32, torch.bfloat16])
+def test_graph_pieces_join_the_dispatch_before_they_end(group, dtype):
+    """Piecewise capture splits the stages at the mixer's attention op, here
+    between the two graphs: the first must join the dispatch it forked, or
+    its capture fails."""
+    moe = _moe(dtype)
+    routed, shared = _inputs(moe)
+    _warm_up(moe, routed, shared)
+    pool = torch.cuda.graph_pool_handle()
+    before, after = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph(), torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with set_forward_context(
+        None, get_current_vllm_config(), cudagraph_runtime_mode=CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE
+    ):
+        with torch.cuda.graph(before, pool=pool):
+            dispatch = moe.begin_staged(routed)
+            projection = shared * 0.5
+            dispatch = moe.receive_staged(dispatch, (projection,))
+        with torch.cuda.graph(after, pool=pool):
+            combine = moe.run_staged_experts(dispatch, projection)
+            output = moe.finish_staged(combine, shared)
+    routed.neg_()
+    shared.mul_(-0.5)
+
+    before.replay()
+    after.replay()
+
+    torch.testing.assert_close(
+        output, _synchronous(moe, routed, shared), atol=0, rtol=0
+    )

+"""How Nemotron Shortcut picks its experts implementation (no GPU needed).

+
+def _moe_config(**overrides) -> NemotronShortcutMoEConfig:
+    values = dict(
+        num_experts=64,
+        experts_per_token=4,
+        hidden_dim=256,
+        intermediate_size=1024,
+        num_local_experts=64,
+        num_logical_experts=64,
+        moe_parallel_config=FusedMoEParallelConfig.make_no_parallel(),
+        activation=MoEActivation.RELU2_NO_MUL,
+        activation_clamp_value=4.0,
+        in_dtype=torch.bfloat16,
+        device="cpu",
+        routing_method=RoutingMethodType.TopK,
+        moe_backend="triton",
+    )
+    values.update(overrides)
+    return NemotronShortcutMoEConfig(**values)
+
+
+def _supported(monkeypatch, cls, supported: bool = True) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(cls, "_supports_current_device", lambda: supported)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "override",
+    [
+        {"pcp_size": 2},
+        {"sp_size": 2},
+        {"enable_eplb": True},
+        {"all2all_backend": "deepep_low_latency"},
+        {"placement": "round_robin"},
+    ],
+)
+def test_expert_parallel_rejects_dispatching_tokens(override):
+    """The experts run every token, so EP must not redistribute tokens."""
+    options = dict(
+        use_ep=True,
+        dp_size=1,
+        pcp_size=1,
+        sp_size=1,
+        enable_eplb=False,
+        all2all_backend="allgather_reducescatter",
+        placement="linear",
+    )
+    options.update(override)
+    layer = SimpleNamespace(expert_placement_strategy=options.pop("placement"))
+    options["is_sequence_parallel"] = override.get("sp_size", 1) != 1
+    config = SimpleNamespace(moe_parallel_config=SimpleNamespace(**options))
+    with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):
+        moe_experts.NemotronShortcutRoutedExperts._get_quant_method(
+            layer, "test", None, config
+        )
+

+    """One checkpoint may mix NVFP4 experts, MXFP8 experts and BF16 experts."""
+    quant = moe_experts.ModelOptMixedPrecisionConfig.from_config(
+        {
+            "quant_algo": "MIXED_PRECISION",
+            "quantized_layers": {
+                "model.language_model.layers.0.moe.experts": {
+                    "quant_algo": "NVFP4",
+                    "group_size": 16,

+                "model.language_model.layers.1.moe.experts": {"quant_algo": "MXFP8"},

+    )

+        (0, "NemotronShortcutModelOptNvFp4MoEMethod", (quant.nvfp4_config, config)),
+        (1, "NemotronShortcutModelOptMxfp8MoEMethod", (config,)),

+            f"language_model.model.layers.{index}.moe.experts",

+@pytest.mark.parametrize("flashinfer", [False, True])
+def test_unquantized_experts_prefer_flashinfer(monkeypatch, flashinfer):

+    expected = (

+    assert type(method.moe_kernel.fused_experts) is expected

+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(

+        ("triton", True, "triton"),
+        ("flashinfer_cutedsl", False, "CuTe-DSL MXFP8 experts are unavailable"),
+        ("marlin", True, "does not implement"),
+        ("flashinfer_trtllm", True, "does not implement"),
+    ],

+def test_mxfp8_experts_selection(monkeypatch, backend, cute_dsl, expected):
+    """Only backends that apply the clamp are chosen; the others are refused."""
+    _supported(
+        monkeypatch, moe_flashinfer.NemotronShortcutCuteDslMxfp8Experts, cute_dsl
+    )
+    _supported(monkeypatch, moe_experts.NemotronShortcutMxfp8TritonExperts)
+    config = _moe_config(moe_backend=backend)
+    classes = {

+        "triton": moe_experts.NemotronShortcutMxfp8TritonExperts,
+    }
+    if expected not in classes:
+        with pytest.raises(ValueError, match=expected):
+            moe_experts.select_mxfp8_experts(config)
+        return
+    assert moe_experts.select_mxfp8_experts(config) is classes[expected]
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("num_experts,local,offset", [(64, 32, 32), (10, 3, None)])
+def test_nvfp4_expert_parallel_requires_even_partitions(
+    monkeypatch, num_experts, local, offset
+):
+    monkeypatch.setattr(moe_flashinfer, "has_cute_dsl_options", lambda *_: True)
+    parallel = replace(
+        FusedMoEParallelConfig.make_no_parallel(),
+        use_ep=True,
+        ep_size=2 if offset else 3,
+        ep_rank=1,
+        dp_size=2 if offset else 3,
+        dp_rank=1,
+    )
+    config = _moe_config(
+        num_experts=num_experts,
+        num_logical_experts=num_experts,
+        experts_per_token=2,
+        num_local_experts=local,
+        moe_parallel_config=parallel,
+    )
+    quant = FusedMoEQuantConfig.make(quant_dtype="nvfp4")
+    if offset is None:
+        with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError, match="split evenly"):
+            moe_flashinfer.NemotronShortcutCuteDslNvFp4Experts(config, quant)
+        return
+    experts = moe_flashinfer.NemotronShortcutCuteDslNvFp4Experts(config, quant)
+    assert experts.local_expert_offset == offset
+    assert experts.clamp == 4.0
+
+
+def test_experts_claim_only_the_non_gated_relu2():
+    for cls in (
+        moe_experts.NemotronShortcutTritonExperts,
+        moe_experts.NemotronShortcutMxfp8TritonExperts,
+        moe_flashinfer.NemotronShortcutFlashInferExperts,

+    ):
+        assert cls._supports_activation(MoEActivation.RELU2_NO_MUL)
+        assert not cls._supports_activation(MoEActivation.SILU)

+        x = self.inputs[:rows]

+        query_start[1:] = query_lens.cumsum(0)
+        request = torch.arange(spec.batch_size).repeat_interleave(query_lens)
+        new = torch.arange(len(request)) - query_start[request]
+        self.request = request.cuda()
+        self.position = ((seq_lens - query_lens)[request] + new).cuda()
+        cached = (torch.arange(self.length) < (seq_lens - query_lens)[:, None]).cuda()
+        if cached.any():
+            self.write_cached_keys(cached)
+        position = self.position.clamp(min=0)  # a padding row has none
+        slots = self.slots[: len(request)]
+        slots.copy_(
+            self.slot[self.request, position].masked_fill(self.position < 0, -1)
+        )
+        self.slot_mapping = dict.fromkeys(self.names, slots)
+        self.lengths[0, : len(query_start)] = query_start
+        self.lengths[1, : spec.batch_size] = seq_lens
+        common = CommonAttentionMetadata(
+            query_start_loc=self.lengths[0, : len(query_start)],
+            query_start_loc_cpu=query_start,
+            seq_lens=self.lengths[1, : spec.batch_size],
+            seq_lens_cpu_upper_bound=seq_lens + self.slack,
+            num_reqs=spec.batch_size,
+            num_actual_tokens=len(request),
+            max_query_len=max(spec.query_lens, default=0),
+            max_seq_len=max(spec.seq_lens, default=0),
+            block_table_tensor=self.table[: spec.batch_size],
+            slot_mapping=slots,
+        )
+        self.metadata = {}  # a host sync here fails a test that forbids them
+        for name, builder in zip(self.names, self.builders):
+            self.metadata[name] = gsd.with_gpu_sync_check(builder.build)(0, common)
+        rows, new_keys = len(request), self.history[self.request, position]
+        self.inputs[:rows, 0, :128] = grid_keys(rows, 128)  # the indexer query
+        self.inputs[:rows, 0, 128:] = new_keys[:, :128]
+        self.inputs[:rows, 1:-2].normal_()  # the core query
+        self.inputs[:rows, -2:] = new_keys[:, 128:].unflatten(1, (2, HEAD))
+        return self.split_inputs(rows)
+
+    def run(self, steps, indexer_query=None) -> None:
+        """Run each step eagerly, and check it."""
+        for spec in steps:
+            inputs = self.step(spec)
+            if indexer_query is not None:
+                inputs[0].fill_(indexer_query)
+            mapping = self.slot_mapping
+            with set_forward_context(self.metadata, self.config, slot_mapping=mapping):
+                self.check(inputs, self.layer(*inputs))
+
+    def check(self, inputs: list[torch.Tensor], output: torch.Tensor) -> None:
+        """Each row selects distinct keys that score as its K best, and the
+        output is softmax attention over them."""
+        rows, top_k, core = len(self.position), self.sdsa.top_k, self.layer.core
+        selected = self.selected_positions(rows)
+        current_workspace_manager()._current_workspaces[0].fill_(0xA5)
+        counts = (self.position + 1).clamp(min=0, max=top_k)
+        valid = torch.arange(top_k, device="cuda") < counts[:, None]
+        assert torch.equal(selected >= 0, valid)
+        ordered = selected.sort(1).values
+        assert not ((ordered[:, 1:] == ordered[:, :-1]) & (ordered[:, 1:] >= 0)).any()
+        keys = self.history[..., :128].flatten(0, 1).float()
+        keys_values = self.history[..., 128:].flatten(0, 1).float()
+        query = inputs[2][:rows].float()
+        tolerance = dict(rtol=0.02, atol=0.01)
+        if core.impl.fp8_kv:  # the layer rounds Q, K, V and P to E4M3
+            kv_scale = torch.tensor([K_SCALE] * HEAD + [V_SCALE] * HEAD, device="cuda")
+            keys_values = (keys_values / kv_scale).to(E4M3).float() * kv_scale
+            query = (query / Q_SCALE).to(E4M3).float() * Q_SCALE
+            tolerance = dict(rtol=0.06, atol=0.08)
+        owner = torch.arange(len(keys), device="cuda") // self.length
+        key_position = torch.arange(len(keys), device="cuda") % self.length
+        for start in range(0, rows, 512):
+            chunk = slice(start, start + 512)
+            request, end = self.request[chunk, None], self.position[chunk, None] + 1
+            scores = inputs[0][chunk].float() @ keys.T
+            scores.masked_fill_((owner != request) | (key_position >= end), -torch.inf)
+            columns = request * self.length + selected[chunk].clamp(min=0)
+            chosen = scores.gather(1, columns).masked_fill(~valid[chunk], -torch.inf)
+            best = scores.topk(top_k).values
+            assert torch.equal(chosen.sort(1, descending=True).values, best)
+            key, value = keys_values[columns].chunk(2, -1)
+            logits = query[chunk] @ key.transpose(1, 2) * core.impl.scale
+            logits.masked_fill_(~valid[chunk, None], -torch.inf)
+            attends = counts[chunk] > 0  # a padding row attends to nothing
+            expected = (logits.softmax(-1) @ value)[attends]
+            actual = output[chunk][attends].float()
+            torch.testing.assert_close(actual, expected, **tolerance)
+
+    def selected_positions(self, rows: int) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Each row's selected keys as positions in its request, -1 last. A
+        decode row's are in topk_indices; a prefill row's are its group's union
+        of cache slots, filtered by its mask row (union core), or its own slots
+        (token and FA4 cores). The buffers are then poisoned."""
+        layer, indexer = self.layer, self.metadata[self.names[0]]
+        selected = torch.full((rows, self.sdsa.top_k), -1, device="cuda")
+        decodes = indexer.num_decodes * indexer.decode_rows
+        selected[:decodes] = layer.topk_indices[:decodes]
+        plan = indexer.prefill
+        if plan is not None:
+            tile_rows = (plan.query_rows >= 0).nonzero()[:, 0]
+            query = plan.query_rows[tile_rows]
+            batch = plan.group_batches[tile_rows // plan.group].long()
+            columns = torch.arange(plan.unions.shape[1], device="cuda")
+            chosen = columns < layer.valid_counts[batch, None]
+            if plan.core == "union":
+                bits = layer.mask[query][:, columns // 32] >> columns % 32
+                chosen &= (bits & 1) > 0
+            slots = plan.unions[batch].long().clamp(min=0)
+            positions = self.position_of_slot[slots].masked_fill(~chosen, 2**40)
+            positions = positions.sort(1).values[:, : self.sdsa.top_k]
+            selected[decodes + query] = positions.masked_fill(positions == 2**40, -1)
+        for buffer in (layer.topk_indices, layer.valid_counts, layer.mask):
+            buffer.fill_(-0x5A5A5A5B)
+        return selected
+
+

+def test_sdsa_config_comes_from_the_model_config() -> None:

+    config does not have them, as checkpoints' configs do not. An "auto" k cache
+    dtype is NVFP4 if the checkpoint quantizes the indexer's key projection,
+    BF16 if not; a set one wins."""
+    config = TextConfig(index_topk=512, sdsa_prefill_core="token")
+    expected = SdsaConfig(top_k=512, indexer_dtype="bf16", prefill_core="token")
+    assert get_sdsa_config(config, UNQUANTIZED) == expected

+    """A K other than 512 or 2048, a core that SDSA does not have, and a BF16 k

+    with pytest.raises(ValueError, match="index_topk"):

+    defaults = CompilationConfig(mode=CompilationMode.VLLM_COMPILE)

+"""GDP prefill (the mixer's `gdp_prefill`) and FlashInfer's decode/verify
+kernel in the mixer's argument layout, against the recurrence: per token the
+state decays once, takes `num_householder` beta-gated delta steps, and is read
+out with the query."""
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+import torch.nn.functional as F
+
+from vllm.config import get_current_vllm_config
+from vllm.forward_context import set_forward_context
+from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.gdp import (
+    NemotronShortcutGDPMixer,
+    gdp_prefill,
+    missing_gdp_kernels,
+)
+from vllm.platforms import current_platform
+
+from .utils import build, make_config
+
+pytestmark = pytest.mark.skipif(
+    not current_platform.is_cuda()
+    or not any(current_platform.is_device_capability(cap) for cap in (90, 100, 103))
+    or bool(missing_gdp_kernels()),
+    reason="needs FlashInfer's GDP kernels on SM90 or SM10x",
+)
+KEY, VALUE = 128, 64  # the head widths the decode kernel serves
+
+
+@pytest.fixture(autouse=True)
+def _forward_context(dist_init, workspace_init):
+    with torch.inference_mode(), set_forward_context(None, get_current_vllm_config()):
+        yield
+
+
+def _mixer(heads: int) -> NemotronShortcutGDPMixer:
+    config = make_config(
+        gdp_num_heads=heads,
+        gdp_num_groups=heads,
+        gdp_head_dim=VALUE,
+        gdp_key_head_dim=KEY,
+    )
+    return build(lambda: NemotronShortcutGDPMixer(config, prefix="gdp"))
+
+
+def _normalize(x: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+    x = x.float()
+    return x * torch.rsqrt(x.square().sum(-1, keepdim=True) + 1e-6)
+
+
+def _step(mixer, state, q, k, v, a, b, l2norm: bool = True):
+    """One token of the recurrence over `state` [rows, heads, VALUE, KEY]."""
+    norm = _normalize if l2norm else torch.Tensor.float
+    decay = (-mixer.A_log.exp() * F.softplus(a.float() + mixer.dt_bias)).exp()
+    state *= decay[:, :, None, None]
+    for j in range(mixer.num_householder):
+        key = norm(k[:, j])
+        residual = v[:, j].float() - (state * key[:, :, None]).sum(-1)
+        beta = b[:, j].float().sigmoid()[:, :, None]
+        state += (beta * residual)[:, :, :, None] * key[:, :, None]
+    return (state * norm(q)[:, :, None]).sum(-1) / KEY**0.5
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads", [4, 10, 24])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("width", [1, 4, 8, 16])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("batch", [1, 8])
+def test_decode_kernel_matches_recurrence_and_scatter(width, batch, heads):
+    """Decode and verify keep every accepted token's state snapshot, skip
+    unallocated (-1) slots and leave the other slots alone, also in a graph."""
+    from flashinfer.cake_gdp import cake_gated_delta_product_mtp
+
+    mixer = _mixer(heads)
+    device = mixer.A_log.device
+    torch.manual_seed(123)
+    heads, n = mixer.num_heads, mixer.num_householder
+    q = torch.randn(batch, width, heads, KEY, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    k = torch.randn(batch, width, n, heads, KEY, device=device, dtype=q.dtype)
+    v = torch.randn(batch, width, n, heads, VALUE, device=device, dtype=q.dtype)
+    a = torch.randn(batch, width, heads, device=device, dtype=q.dtype)
+    b = torch.randn(batch, width, n, heads, device=device, dtype=q.dtype)
+    pool = torch.randn(batch * (width + 1) + 1, heads, VALUE, KEY, device=device)
+    original = pool.clone()
+    read = torch.arange(1, batch + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.int32)
+    slots = torch.arange(
+        batch + 1, batch * (width + 1) + 1, device=device, dtype=torch.int32
+    ).reshape(batch, width)
+    slots[-1, -1] = -1  # an unallocated snapshot, as in a ragged window
+    state = original[read.long()].clone()
+    expected_pool = original.clone()
+    expected = torch.empty_like(v[:, :, 0], dtype=torch.float32)
+    for t in range(width):
+        expected[:, t] = _step(
+            mixer, state, q[:, t], k[:, t], v[:, t], a[:, t], b[:, t]
+        )
+        valid = slots[:, t] >= 0
+        expected_pool[slots[valid, t].long()] = state[valid]
+
+    def run(out):
+        return cake_gated_delta_product_mtp(
+            q,
+            k,
+            v,
+            pool,
+            read,
+            mixer.A_log.float(),
+            a,
+            mixer.dt_bias.float(),
+            b,
+            output=out,
+            ssm_state_indices=slots,
+            disable_state_update=False,
+            use_qk_l2norm=True,
+        )
+
+    out = torch.full_like(v[:, :, 0], float("nan"))
+    actual, returned_pool = run(out)
+    assert actual.data_ptr() == out.data_ptr()
+    assert returned_pool.data_ptr() == pool.data_ptr()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(actual.float(), expected, atol=2e-3, rtol=2e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pool, expected_pool, atol=2e-4, rtol=2e-3)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pool[0], original[0], atol=0, rtol=0)
+    graph = torch.cuda.CUDAGraph()
+    with torch.cuda.graph(graph):
+        run(out)
+    pool.copy_(original)
+    graph.replay()
+    torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), expected, atol=2e-3, rtol=2e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(pool, expected_pool, atol=2e-4, rtol=2e-3)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("heads", [4, 24])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("lengths", [(1,), (7, 130), (64, 1, 200)])
+def test_prefill_kernel_matches_recurrence(lengths, heads):
+    """Prefill over packed sequences of different lengths, from initial
+    states, with each token's Householder steps on dim 1."""
+    mixer = _mixer(heads)
+    device = mixer.A_log.device
+    torch.manual_seed(7)
+    heads, n, tokens = mixer.num_heads, mixer.num_householder, sum(lengths)
+    q = _normalize(torch.randn(tokens, heads, KEY, device=device)).bfloat16()
+    k = _normalize(torch.randn(tokens, n, heads, KEY, device=device)).bfloat16()
+    v = torch.randn(tokens, n, heads, VALUE, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    a = torch.randn(tokens, heads, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    b = torch.randn(tokens, n, heads, device=device, dtype=torch.bfloat16)
+    initial = torch.randn(len(lengths), heads, VALUE, KEY, device=device) * 0.1
+    starts = torch.tensor([0, *lengths], device=device).cumsum(0).to(torch.int32)
+    decay = -mixer.A_log.float().exp() * F.softplus(a.float() + mixer.dt_bias)
+    out, last = gdp_prefill(
+        q, k, v, decay, b.float().sigmoid(), initial.clone(), starts
+    )
+    expected = torch.empty(tokens, heads, VALUE, device=device)
+    for request, (start, stop) in enumerate(zip(starts[:-1], starts[1:])):
+        state = initial[request : request + 1].clone()
+        for t in range(int(start), int(stop)):
+            row = slice(t, t + 1)
+            expected[row] = _step(
+                mixer, state, q[row], k[row], v[row], a[row], b[row], l2norm=False
+            )
+        # The kernel sums in chunks, the reference token by token: over 200
+        # tokens a few state entries drift by ~2.5e-3.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(last[request], state[0], atol=5e-3, rtol=2e-2)
+    torch.testing.assert_close(out.float(), expected, atol=2e-2, rtol=2e-2)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Block scales of the fused GDP in_proj are sharded like its weight under TP
+(quantized checkpoints once loaded another rank's scales)."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+
+import pytest
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.models.nemotron_shortcut.nvidia.gdp import install_gdp_in_proj_loaders
+
+K = 64
+SCALE_COLS = K // 32
+
+# The NemotronShortcutGDPMixer packing, [gate, value, key, query, beta, decay], for two
+# householders and small dimensions: (rows, num_householder) per block.
+BLOCKS = [(32, 1), (64, 2), (32, 2), (16, 1), (16, 2), (8, 1)]
+ROWS = sum(rows for rows, _ in BLOCKS)
+
+
+def _row_coded(rows: int, cols: int, dtype: torch.dtype) -> torch.Tensor:
+    # Every element of row i holds i, so a loaded row says which source row it is.
+    return torch.arange(rows).unsqueeze(1).expand(rows, cols).to(dtype).contiguous()
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("tp_size", [2, 4])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("scale_name", ["weight_scale", "weight_scale_inv"])
+def test_in_proj_scales_follow_the_weight_rows(tp_size, scale_name):
+    shard = ROWS // tp_size
+    for tp_rank in range(tp_size):
+        scale = nn.Parameter(
+            torch.empty(shard, SCALE_COLS, dtype=torch.int32), requires_grad=False
+        )
+        in_proj = SimpleNamespace(
+            weight=nn.Parameter(torch.empty(shard, K), requires_grad=False),
+            **{scale_name: scale},
+        )
+        install_gdp_in_proj_loaders(in_proj, BLOCKS, tp_size, tp_rank)
+
+        weight = _row_coded(ROWS, K, torch.float32)
+        in_proj.weight.weight_loader(in_proj.weight, weight)
+        scale.weight_loader(scale, _row_coded(ROWS, SCALE_COLS, torch.int32))
+
+        # Row i of the rank's scales belongs to row i of its weight.
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            scale.data, in_proj.weight.data[:, :SCALE_COLS].to(torch.int32)
+        )

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""SDSA through the whole engine on a tiny random-weight Nemotron Shortcut, so
+no checkpoint is needed: build, compile, the KV cache shared with GDP layers,
+chunked prefill, CUDA graphs, TP2 and MTP. The sdsa/ tests check the selection."""
+
+import random
+
+import torch
+
+from tests.conftest import VllmRunner
+from tests.models.nemotron_shortcut.utils import (
+    make_config,
+    realistic_weights,
+    save_checkpoint_config,
+)
+from tests.models.utils import check_logprobs_close
+from tests.utils import multi_gpu_marks
+from vllm import SamplingParams
+
+pytestmark = multi_gpu_marks(num_gpus=2)
+
+K = 512  # each query attends to its Top-K keys
+VOCAB = 32  # few tokens, so that random MTP drafts are often accepted
+rng = random.Random(0)
+# Two prompts of at most K tokens, and one of 3K tokens, prefilled in chunks.
+# The last token id is the image token, so the prompts do not use it.
+PROMPTS = [[rng.randrange(VOCAB - 1) for _ in range(n)] for n in (300, K - 8, 3000)]
+
+
+def run(path, index_topk, **kwargs) -> tuple[list, dict]:
+    """Greedy outputs for PROMPTS at TP2, with SDSA (`index_topk`) or full
+    attention (None), and the engine's metrics."""
+    with VllmRunner(
+        str(path),
+        trust_remote_code=True,  # the checkpoint's config is remote code
+        load_format="dummy",
+        skip_tokenizer_init=True,
+        hf_overrides={"text_config": {"index_topk": index_topk}},
+        tensor_parallel_size=2,
+        dtype="bfloat16",
+        max_model_len=4096,
+        block_size=None,  # type: ignore[arg-type]  # the hybrid model picks it
+        enable_chunked_prefill=True,
+        max_num_batched_tokens=512,
+        limit_mm_per_prompt={"image": 0, "video": 0},
+        disable_log_stats=False,
+        **kwargs,
+    ) as vllm:
+        vllm.llm.apply_model(realistic_weights)
+        params = SamplingParams(
+            temperature=0, max_tokens=256, logprobs=5, prompt_logprobs=0
+        )
+        outputs = vllm.llm.generate([{"prompt_token_ids": p} for p in PROMPTS], params)
+        return outputs, {m.name: m for m in vllm.llm.get_metrics()}
+
+
+def prompt_logprobs(output) -> torch.Tensor:
+    """Entry i is the log prob of prompt token i + 1, which sees i + 1 keys."""
+    tokens, steps = output.prompt_token_ids[1:], output.prompt_logprobs[1:]
+    return torch.tensor([step[token].logprob for token, step in zip(tokens, steps)])
+
+
+def test_sdsa_engine(tmp_path, monkeypatch) -> None:
+    """Up to K keys SDSA keeps every key, so it scores the prompts as full
+    attention does, within 0.05 (the kernels differ; measured at most 0.03).
+    Past K it attends to K keys, so the long prompt's scores move away, by 0.03
+    on average (measured 0.06). MTP drafts do not change greedy decoding, so
+    SDSA with drafts picks full attention's tokens on the short prompts, and
+    some drafts are accepted."""
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_WORKER_MULTIPROC_METHOD", "spawn")
+    # apply_model sends realistic_weights to the workers by pickle.
+    monkeypatch.setenv("VLLM_ALLOW_INSECURE_SERIALIZATION", "1")
+    # No MoE layers: router near-ties would flip experts between the two runs.
+    layers = ["linear_attention"] * 3 + ["full_attention"]
+    text = make_config(
+        layer_types=layers * 2,
+        vocab_size=VOCAB,
+        hidden_size=1024,
+        num_attention_heads=8,
+        head_dim=256,
+        # GDP's kernels take 64-dim heads and 128-dim keys.
+        gdp_num_heads=8,
+        gdp_num_groups=8,
+        gdp_head_dim=64,
+        gdp_key_head_dim=128,
+        max_position_embeddings=4096,
+        num_nextn_predict_layers=1,
+        tie_word_embeddings=False,
+    )
+    save_checkpoint_config(tmp_path, text, image_token_id=VOCAB - 1)
+
+    mtp = {"method": "mtp", "num_speculative_tokens": 2}
+    sdsa, metrics = run(tmp_path, K, speculative_config=mtp)
+    full, _ = run(tmp_path, None)
+
+    for sdsa_prompt, full_prompt in zip(sdsa, full):
+        difference = prompt_logprobs(sdsa_prompt) - prompt_logprobs(full_prompt)
+        assert difference[:K].abs().max() < 0.05
+    difference = prompt_logprobs(sdsa[-1]) - prompt_logprobs(full[-1])
+    assert difference[K:].abs().mean() > 0.03
+    check_logprobs_close(
+        outputs_0_lst=[
+            (o.outputs[0].token_ids, "", o.outputs[0].logprobs) for o in sdsa[:2]
+        ],
+        outputs_1_lst=[
+            (o.outputs[0].token_ids, "", o.outputs[0].logprobs) for o in full[:2]
+        ],
+        name_0="sdsa_mtp",
+        name_1="full",
+    )
+    assert metrics["vllm:spec_decode_num_accepted_tokens"].value > 0

+    """Build a module on the platform device with small finite parameters."""
+    torch.manual_seed(0)

+    """Scale matrices to +-1/sqrt(fan_in), norms to 1: dummy weights are +-1e-3."""
